Why Tekcentral

Engineers with a teacher’s heart

Frank and Niamh founded Tekcentral in 2016, bringing backgrounds in electronic and computer engineering into classrooms, libraries and our own hub. Every lesson plan is written in-house.

Proud nerds since 2016

Learning by doing

Students build real things every week: games, robots, circuits and 3D prints.

The engineering design process

We teach how to break a problem down, test ideas and improve them.

Pitched to every level

From primary school beginners to secondary students ready for text-based code.

Confidence and friends

Inclusive, collaborative classes where kids share ideas and help each other.

  • Scratch
  • MakeCode Arcade

  • C++
  • 3D design
